PokeN_RedHouse.title: Red house
PokeN_RedHouse.drawn: Two copies of the red house: a steep red gable roof with its ridge front to back under a light band, grey verges, a shed dormer on its right slope and a brick chimney at its back, the upper floor's two wide windows over flower boxes between dark timbers, a dark beam, the ground floor's cream walls between stone quoins, a bay window under a red awning and the blue double door.

PokeN_Chalet.title: Chalet
PokeN_Chalet.drawn: The house at the top: a wing on the left under a steep hipped roof with a white fascia, its door with a pane and a lamp beside it; an A-frame block a tile forward on the right under a very steep gable with a flat top, its cream gable with dark braces and three windows under a white verge, two windows below between timber posts; a tall pale chimney down its right slope.

PokeN_RoofedGate.title: Roofed gate
PokeN_RoofedGate.drawn: The gate over the path at the bottom: a low roof of brown planks under a dark cap on two dark posts, its shadow across the path; no walls.
